1.
Heard learned counsel for the Applicant and learned App for the State.

2.  This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with CR No.398 of 2023 registered with Baramati police station for offences punishable under Sections 408 and 420 of Indian Penal Code,
1860.
3.
The Applicant is protected under order dated 06.09.2023.

sentences.text: The Applicant had shown willingness to deposit the amount of Rs.21,00,599.25 in 2 installments in this Court without prejudice to rights and contentions and on considering such statement, this Court had granted the interim protection.
5. It is recorded in earlier orders that the said amount is already 69 ABA-2478-2023.doc deposited in this Court.

6. Learned APP on instructions of officer of the concerned police station (who is present in the Court) submits that the custodial interrogation of the Applicant is not required and the investigation is practically over for the present Applicant.
7. Perusal of the FIR indicates that the accused are Chairman, Secretary and Joint Secretary of the concerned credit society and misappropriation of total Rs. 21,00,599.25 is alleged.

8. Considering the nature of the allegations and that the Applicant was protected for last about 2 years and that the Applicant has deposited the amount mentioned in the FIR in the Court as per condition imposed by this Court, a case of grant of anticipatory bail is made out.
9. Anticipatory bail application is allowed in terms of order dated 06.09.2023.
The Applicant is directed to attend the Trial on its commencement regularly, unless exempted by the concerned Trial Court.
10. Anticipatory bail application is disposed of.

(M.M. SATHAYE, J.)
